problem: Choose the cheapest zero-cost local intervention-capable backend for the model-specific Global J-Space causal control family without creating a second state or effect authority.

observed_sources.observed: Project documentation describes local execution on PyTorch models, access to layer activations, activation modification for causal interventions, gradients over intermediate values, and batching of interventions.
Current source exposes intervenable models, original/intervened outputs and collected activations, with hook-based intervention machinery and trainable/static intervention types.
Official Qwen model card identifies a 0.6B causal language model with 28 layers, Transformers loading support and Apache-2.0 license.

hypothesis: NNsight plus Qwen3-0.6B is the lowest-friction first discriminator because NNsight can wrap a local torch.nn.Module directly, reducing model-specific intervention-mapping work while still exposing named activation sites and mutation needed for matched causal controls.
counterhypothesis: pyvene may provide a more structured and reproducible intervention abstraction once Qwen model-component mappings are verified; the generic NNsight path may otherwise permit accidental site/shape drift unless EntityOS binds module path, tensor metadata and intervention identity explicitly.

acceptance: the corrupted baseline measurably changes the declared target metric relative to clean
the target intervention changes the target metric beyond matched sham and off-target controls
all five members bind the same exact model/runtime/tokenizer/checkpoint family and differ only in declared intervention variables
rerun at fixed inputs/seeds preserves the declared qualitative ordering within a predeclared tolerance
no intervention output mints canonical truth or bypasses EffectGate/EffectJournal
first_discriminator.falsifier: If NNsight cannot bind a stable named Qwen3-0.6B activation site under exact local runtime identity, or target effects fail to separate from sham/off-target controls, do not grant J-Space causal credit; test pyvene next or reject the intervention hypothesis.
